desc: Implement a helper function for modular exponentiation to compute (base^exp) % mod.
Implement a helper function to compute nCr modulo 10^9+7 using precomputed factorials or direct computation since n-1 <= 10^5.
In the main function, compute the binomial coefficient C(n-1, k) modulo 10^9+7.
Multiply the results from steps 3 and 4 modulo 10^9+7 and return the result.
